ONTARIO  COURT  OF
JUSTICE

CITATION:
R. v. Sears,
2019 ONCJ

DATE:  2019·01·24

COURT FILE No.:  Toronto 4817 998
18-70010807-01;-02

BETWEEN:

HER  MAJESTY  THE  QUEEN

—  AND  —

JAMES SEARS and LEROY ST. GERMAINE

Before Justice Richard Blouin

Heard on November
28, 29, December 3, 4, and 12, 2018

Oral Submissions
heard on January 16, 2019

Reasons for
Judgment released on January 24, 2019

Ms. Jamie Klukach .................................................................................   counsel
for the Crown

Mr. Robin Flumerfelt .............................................................................   counsel
for the Crown

Ms. Erica Whitford  ................................................................................   counsel

BLOUIN,  J.:

Introduction

[
1
]

The defendants are the editor and publisher
of a community newspaper,
Your Ward News
(YWN), which is distributed to
over 300,000 homes centred in the Beaches neighbourhood of Toronto. It also is
available on-line with a readership claim exceeding one million. They are
charged under
s. 319(2)
of the
Criminal Code

with two counts of wilful
promotion of hatred against an identifiable group – Jews and women. Both
defendants admitted in an Agreed Statement of Facts (Exhibit 1) that these two
groups meet the definition of “identifiable groups” under s. 319(7). It was
also admitted that Mr. St. Germaine, as publisher, is aware of the
publication’s content and distribution. All 22 issues of YWN published between
January 2015 and Summer 2018 were filed as Exhibit 2.

[
2
]

The Crown called two expert witnesses, Dr.
Derek Penslar, a professor of history, and Professor Janine Benedet, a law
professor. The defence conceded that both could be qualified as experts. I am
grateful to counsel for their sensible concessions which greatly reduced the
length of the trial. The defendants did not testify and called no evidence. Mr.
St. Germaine gave a statement to police which was conceded as voluntary. The
issues were reduced to whether or not the content of YWN rose to the level of
hatred, and, if it did, whether or not the defendants wilfully promoted that
hatred. It was conceded that the law allows for the concept of wilful blindness
to provide a foundation for criminal liability. The Crown is not required to prove
that any actual harm was caused by the prohibited com­muni­cation.

[
3
]

Both defendants submitted that any comments
expressed in YWN must be viewed contextually. When all 22 issues are examined,
one is left with unfocused and absurd opinions, contradictory messages, and scattershot
ramblings. Except for its stated claims of being the world’s largest anti-Marxist
publication, YWN exhibits no unifying concept. The paper, they argue, uses
satire and comical images to portray views that many would consider to be
highly offensive, but that those views fall short of hate promotion. One
argument contends that the need to employ experts by the Crown, in and of
itself, recognizes the obscurity of the material.

[
4
]

Given the above submission, I think it is
important to deal with the evidence of both experts at this point. I will first
say that both were extremely impressive. They both provided the Court with a
historical background to many issues written about in YWN. They both
communicated their opinions regarding anti-Semitism and misogyny succinctly and
authoritatively. More impressively, they both enhanced the strength of their
opinions by responding thoughtfully to questions and challenges in
cross-examination. I had no trouble accepting either expert’s evidence. As
helpful and impressive as they turned out to be, in my view, they were not
necessary. The agreed statement of facts (Exhibit 1), Mr. St. Germaine’s police
statement (Exhibit 18), and Exhibit 2 (the 22 issues of YWN) provide a complete
factual foundation for my analysis.

[
5
]

The defendants took the position that YWN is
primarily anti-Marxist. I agree with that assessment. That is a unifying theme,
especially in the earlier editions where the focus seems to be on attacking
left-wing politicians. I also accept that while a listing of excerpts of alleged
examples of hate, as provided by the Crown in closing submissions, is helpful,
the whole body of each issue must be examined. Since the excerpts were
expansive, I will append them as Appendix A (with correction notes) to this
judgment.

Prior Discreditable Conduct

[
6
]

In late August, the Crown made application that
evidence of prior discreditable conduct regarding Mr. Sears ought to be
admitted in this trial. I ruled, a few weeks later, that the following evidence
would be admitted into the trial record (and made Exhibit 17):

•

two convictions for sexual assault in 1991;

•

a medical licence revocation hearing before the
Discipline Committee of the College of Physicians and Surgeons in 1992, wherein
the defendant’s licence to practice medicine was revoked;

•

screenshots of Dimitri the Lover’s website,
tweets and blog article.

[
7
]

I concluded that the probative value on the
issue of intent outweighed the minimal prejudicial effect regarding the above
three categories of evidence. I, however, excluded police occurrence reports
regarding alleged inappropriate conduct as not relevant or probative. I can now
say, at the conclusion of this trial, that none of that evidence factored into
my decision, since, in my view, there was abundant evidence regarding Mr.
Sears’ intent available in Exhibit 2 without referencing his prior conduct.

Is this hate or simply distasteful expression?

[
8
]

In the seminal case of
R. v. Keegstra,

1990 CanLII 24 (SCC)
, [1990] S.C.J. No. 131, the constitutionality of the hate speech provisions of
the
Criminal Code
was at issue. The Supreme Court of Canada ruled that
these laws did violate freedom of expression (s. 2 of the
Charter
) but
were saved by s. 1 as being a limitation necessary in a free and democratic
society.

[
9
]

In the analysis, the Court examined the
objective of
s. 319(2)
. Only if there are pressing and substantial concerns can
the legislative limits on a
Charter
right be permissible. In 1965, the
Cohen Committee noted that hate propaganda not only denigrated and humiliated,
and thereby caused harm to, the target group but, also, that it could attract
adherents with the attendant result of discrimination, and perhaps violence,
against minority groups in Canada.

[
10
]

In
Keegstra
, Chief Justice Dickson
wrote at paragraph 116, “Noting the purpose of
s. 319(2)
, in my opinion the
term “hatred” connotes emotion of an intense and extreme nature that is clearly
associated with vilification and detestation.” He later writes in the same
paragraph that hatred “implies that those individuals are to be despised,
scorned, denied respect and made subject to ill-treatment on the basis of group
affiliation.”

[
11
]

After considering the entirety of Exhibit 2,
a consistent and obvious theme that radiated from this publication was hatred.
It was at times contradictory in that love was professed to Jews and some women.
It was at times satirical in that humour and exaggeration were employed to make
the point. But hatred of Jews and women was overwhelmingly the message.

[
12
]

As noted above, a contextual approach to the
views expressed in YWN is necessary. However, there were representative examples
of vilification and detestation that leapt off the page. Women were represented
as immoral, inferior, and not human. Mr. Sears celebrated sexual and physical violations
towards them. Jews were consistently blamed, demonized, and maligned. In my
view, YWN repeatedly and consistently dehumanised Jews and women, and I
conclude both men intended to publish hate. No other intent can be inferred from
a complete reading of this newspaper.

[
13
]

The preeminent concern noted a half century
ago, that hate propaganda could contribute to violence, is starkly relevant
today. The Toronto van attack in April 2018, the Quebec mosque attack in
January 2017, and the Pittsburgh synagogue attack a few months ago, are all
present day displays of extreme hatred of identifiable groups. The extent to
which hate propaganda, such as that which YWN publishes, bears responsibility
in these cases, is still undergoing investigation.

Examples of Hate

[
14
]

Mr. Sears (under his pen-name Dimitri the
Lover) writes it was an “insane idea” to grant women the right to vote. Women
do not have the “mental faculties or temperament (sic) required to make
consistently rational voting decisions…” (Spring 2017)

Most women are
irrational, short-sighted, passive-aggressive traitors who cannot be trusted
with a vote. That is why we keep electing charming assholes who sell us out to
foreign interests, corrupt the morals of our society, and open the gates of our
nation to ungrateful foreigners who seek to rape, pillage and plunder out
country.

[
15
]

Dimitri the Lover also advocates jury nullification
by men becoming “lone wolf gender warriors” to allow other men to be acquitted
on sexual assault trials. He cites his concerns (Fall 2016):

In a
non-feminized country, no man would ever face criminal charges merely for
groping a juicy ass, tugging on a pair of rip tits, or raping a woman who
cockteased him incessantly. But as the FemiMarxist tide sweeps across the
western world, more and more countries are adopting evolutionarily backward
laws whose sole purpose is to psychologically castrate men. In most western countries
today, even ravaging one’s own chattel (“raping” one’s wife) has been
criminalized!

He adds later that
women can lie without remorse because they lack the moral fibre of men.

[
16
]

Bemoaning a feminized culture, where men
have become “pussy-whipped fags”, Mr. Sears recalls a previous generation where
“rarely a day passed by where I did not witness a man pinning his woman up
against a wall by her shoulders or meting out a strategic slap” (January 2016).
Referring to a Russian punk band’s protest in a Christian cathedral in Moscow
in 2012, as a desecration ordered by their Jewish handlers, Mr. Sears refers to
the four women as “satanic whores” and “FemiMarxist cunts that deserved the
horse-whip beating they received” (February 2016).

[
17
]

Not only are there references in YWN to the
necessity of women submitting to the “natural patriarchal order” as God
intended (Summer 2018), but, further, that no society can survive unless women
remain men’s
chattel
(Summer 2017). To further illustrate the point, Mr.
Sears writes that rape laws exist not to protect the woman, but her owner. If
you rape a woman, you are defiling a man’s chattel – like scratching his
vehicle (Summer 2017). His alter ego, Dimitri the Lover, refers to sexual
assault charges as “speeding tickets on the seduction highway” (Summer 2016).
He further writes that Dimitri has pinned down more women against their will
than any man or diesel dyke in Canada.

[
18
]

In the Summer 2018 edition of YWN there is a
two-page article by Dimitri the Lover entitled Vax Juice + Femmo Abuse =
Homicidal Recluse. Mr. Sears attempts to explain the reasons behind the
terrorist attack on Yonge Street in Toronto in April 2018, which killed ten
people. He writes that he learned that the perpetrator (I intentionally will
not refer to him by name) was a vaccine-damaged man on the autism spectrum.
Then he writes:

Now it all made sense. I guarantee you that
some cruel feminist cunt set him off. Trust me on that. She and the vaccine
manufacturers are just as responsible for those dead bodies as he is.

[
19
]

Mr. Sears then writes about a “misandrous
feminist ideology” that victimizes and destroys young white men in our society.
These men can be assisted to avoid inevitable violence by Mr. Sears providing a
safe space where they can vent their frustrations before resorting to violence.
He states that YWN provides these young men an “outlet” before they turn to
violence.

[
20
]

However, in the last two paragraphs of the
article, Sears places the blame on women who do not submit to the patriarchal
order:

Canada and the rest of the western world is
about to enter the “InCel Fight Club” era, where formerly “Lone-Wolf” InCels
begin forming cells which will ultimately morph from vandalism and sophomoric
havoc, to mass violence. The sooner women start treating young white men with
respect, and we stop damaging our children with vaccines, the better. I am
confident we can turn this situation around in one generation with minimal
bloodshed. But ladies, it has to start
NOW
with
YOU
!
Begin submitting to the natural Patriarchal order, and stop being so shallow
and materialistic…choose men based on general health over faggish good looks;
and intelligence/vocation over lifestyle thrills.

I will do my part after my “hate speech”
trial ends in early December, and my time greatly frees up, by resurrecting
“Toronto
Real Men”
meetings so that I can give men like Minassian a safe space where
they can vent their frustrations before they are channeled into a violent act.
What can the rest of you men do? Fight femi-Marxist ideology wherever you can.
If you see a vile woman emotionally or verbally-abusing a man that is either
unwilling or incapable of fighting back, step in and
SHUT HER DOWN
,
with extreme prejudice. Only then can we rid the Earth of misandrous ideology,
circumvent the dystopian future we are hurling towards, and guarantee that we
resurrect our
Brave
Old
World
; one based on the natural order, as
God intended.

[
21
]

Dr. Penslar is a professor of European
Jewish History at the University of Toronto and also a professor of Modern
Jewish History at Harvard. Based on his review of all YWN issues published between
2015 and 2018 (Exhibit 2), he determined that this publication “espouses
anti-Semitic doctrines and that both its textual and visual representations of
Jews are rooted in anti-Semitic concepts with a long historical pedigree.”

YWN
consistently expresses hatred of Jews via five distinct yet overlapping
mechanism: 1) Expressions of revulsion against Jewish faith and its
practitioners; 2) Accusations that Jews were collectively responsible for
Bolshevik atrocities in the USSR; 3) Claims of Jewish conspiracies to conquer
and control humanity, especially through banking and finance; 4) Demonization
of the state of Israel; 5) Holocaust denial.

[
22
]

Mr. Sears writes often about the cultural
eradication of Jews in that they are misguided and could be perfected as
Christians. In the Winter 2017 edition, he writes about a vision he had:

The other key element of this downloading
of knowledge from the cosmos was that I learned time was of the essence to
perfect the Jews, because during one of the three years that I had envisioned,
“The
Great Pogrom”
would commence (I was not made privy as to which year). Only
144,000 Jews (about 1%) would survive because they followed their Torah
TO
THE LETTER
and rejected the Satanic Babylonian Talmud. The only hope for
the other 99% of Jews was to come to Jesus Christ.

[
23
]

Dr. Penslar writes about historical
anti-Semitic themes regarding Jews’ ritual murder of Christian youth and then
consuming their blood. In the Winter 2018 edition, a collage illustrates the
Prime Minister, who is being controlled by Jewish financier George Soros,
drinking the blood of children (poured from a Chateaux Rothschild bottle).

[
24
]

George Soros is illustrated as a puppeteer
complete with horns and other satanic imagery.

[
25
]

The Rothschild family is portrayed as
controlling the banking system which accords with a longstanding anti-Semitic
attack.

[
26
]

Mr. Sears, consistently throughout the
publication, denied the Holocaust and glorified Adolf Hitler.

Not All Jews and Not All Women

[
27
]

Another theme the defendants submitted as
evidence of the absence of proof on these charges was that the writings do not
attack Jews or women as a whole group. The Talmud is characterized as a satanic
book but that not all Jews are deserving of hatred because of it. In addition,
it is argued in YWN that present day Jews are not responsible for the sins of
their ancestors. The primary goal, stated many times, is to bring Jews to
Jesus. And, in the case of women, any negative comment is directed toward
feminists, and the results of feminism generally, and not to all women.

[
28
]

I accept there are ostensibly benign views
of both Jews and women expressed at times in YWN, however, when read as an
entire body, Jews are often represented with satanic horns, reptilian features,
drinking the blood of children, and financiers controlling the levers of power
as puppeteers. There is an undeniable glorification of Adolph Hitler and extensive
use of Nazi imagery. The New Constitution Party of Canada, headed by Mr. Sears,
incorporates, among other things, “the heart of Chancellor Adolf Hitler”. To
add to that, to continually represent the extermination of six million Jews as
a “hoax”, and to specifically claim that “Nazis never slaughtered people,” and
that “any deaths were unintentional” (page 19, Spring 2017) not only negate any
reasonable view of history, but fosters hate towards a cultural entity that
would purport such an outrageous claim, or “hoax”.

[
29
]

Similarly, the claim that only feminists, and
not all women, are labelled for scorn is contradicted by a complete examination
of Exhibit 2. Any position communicated that essentially denies that an entire
half of the world’s population are human beings is so outrageously
reprehensible that the word “hate” is starkly inadequate. One cannot refer to
people as chattel, advocating violence against them, demeaning them as inferior
to men, without promoting hatred towards them.

Wilful promotion of Hatred

[
30
]

In my view, there exists significant
evidence of the promotion of that hatred which undeniably illustrates their
intent to pass on to others the message of hate towards Jews and women.

[
31
]

Firstly, YWN claims to reach 300,000 with a
readership of over one million. According to Mr. St. Germaine’s statement to police,
the cost of production and delivery of each issue ranges from $50,000 -
$70,000. Financing is obtained through donations from entities in Canada and
the United States. Mr. Sears writes in the May 2018 issue that he is “a
fearless, obsessed man with VERY DEEP POCKETS who is loved and admired by MANY
WEALTHY SYMPATHIZERS.” It is obvious the defendants were intent on attracting
resources to spread or provide their anti-Marxist, but also anti-Semitic and
misogynist, message.

[
32
]

Secondly, there are, throughout the
publication, sometimes subtle but unmistakeable calls to actions, which, in my
view, not only display hatred, but promote it:

•

The Summer 2018 edition speaks of the
perpetrator of the April 2018 van attack in Toronto as not a terrorist but a
victim of toxic vaccines, and a misandrous, feminist ideology. Mr. Sears
purports to offer an alternative to mass violence by offering “incels”
counselling on how to be a real man. However, women must start treating young
men with respect by obeying the natural patriarchal order. Men are counselled
to fight the “femi-Marxist ideology” wherever they can. “If you see a vile
woman emotionally or verbally abusing a man that is either unwilling or
incapable of fighting back step in and
SHUT HER DOWN
with
extreme
prejudice
(my italics). Only then can we rid the Earth of misandrous
ideology.” (As a side note, I recall a memorable scene at the beginning of the
1979 film Apocalypse Now. A soldier is given a mission to terminate the command
of a superior who has gone insane. He is told to terminate that command,
with
extreme prejudice
, which clearly meant, to kill him.)

•

The Fall 2017 edition deals with Mr. Sears, as
resident Jewologist (sic), reviewing prospects of converting Jews to
Christianity. He relates a vision sent from God inspiring him to “build a
spiritual ark to take Jews on a voyage of salvation.” He feels Jews to be in
danger from the Alt Right: “My main goal in pointing out Jew’s crimes has been
to shatter their supremacist myth, have them experience an anti-humanist
epiphany, and connect to Christianity en masse.” He then provides some conversion
resources.

•

The Fall 2016 edition advises every man to
become a “LONE WOLF GENDER WARRIOR” by using jury nullification to “nullify
laws which unfairly discriminate against men. Some of those laws include
statutory rape, and domestic assault cases where “the women the deserved to be
raped or smacked.”

Near the conclusion of
the article, Dimitri the Lover writes:

REMEMBER
:
Laws are supposed to prevent bad people from doing bad things, and
good people from getting fucked over by bad people or by a system corrupted by
bad people. As a man, you have dominion over all creatures, so it is your
MORAL
DUTY
to protect the meek and innocent, and to mete out justice to the
evil and guilty.

Application of s. 319(3)(c) Defence

[
33
]

Mr. St. Germaine, in written submissions, submits
that there is evidence that the statutory defence outlined in s. 319(3)(c) is
available to him. Again, it was conceded that as publisher, Mr. St. Germaine is
aware of the content and distribution of YWN. Mr. St. Germaine told police that
he has the final say on the content. He maintained that he didn’t think that
Sears was crossing any lines and that he trusts his knowledge and ability. St.
Germaine read all of the articles and did his own research if he felt that to
be warranted.

[
34
]

Mr. St. Germaine argued that his police
statement provided the basis upon which I could conclude that he reasonably
believed the statements made regarding Jews and women as true since he fact
checks before publication. As indicated above, to believe that one should
celebrate Hitler and deny the Holocaust of Jews by the Nazis, has no basis in
reason. To advocate rape and proclaim women to be less than human, has no basis
in reason.

Conclusion

[
35
]

I conclude that both men were fully aware of
the unrelenting promotion of hate in YWN and intended that hatred to be
delivered to others.  Both are found guilty as charged on each count.

Released:    January 24, 2019

Signed: “Justice Blouin”

1.

The misogynistic
messages conveyed by
YWN
are evocative of the types of expression
and devices used to expose groups to hatred.  These “hallmarks of hatred” include:

Blaming women for perceived societal problems and ills

•

Feminism is blamed
for “chemically and psychologically castrating Western men” and James Sears
offers seduction counselling to teach men how to tame FemiMarxist shrews. (Tab
11, p. 9)

•

Feminism uses
women “for the purpose of inflaming hatred against the Christian religion,
hatred against men, hatred against the beauty of women, hatred against the
equilibrium of families.” (Tab 12, p. 16)

•

Feminism needs to
be dismantled for the good of society:  “the greatest threat to the survival of

chattel.” (Tab 18, p. 10)

•

Feminist
organizations are backed by shadowy forces intent on destroying Western

De-humanizing women as being inferior to men and
deserving of unequal treatment

•

There is a natural
order of “male authority and female submission.” (Tab 18, p. 10)

•

The election of Donald
Trump heralds “the year of the Cock, … representing the reestablishment of
God’s benevolent Patriarchy during which strong, powerful polygamous men will
destroy Feminist ideology and protect all of God’s flock from Satan”. (Tab 16,
p. 7)

•

Article titled
“Menstruation Nation Bows to the Patriarchy!” celebrates the victory of a

GENDER WARRIER in the war to rid society of ‘Cultural Marxist filth’.”  (Tab
16, pp. 10-11)

Women of colour are further demeaned:

•

Women of colour
are worthy of seduction if they are attractive by “European standards”. The
author rates “Negressess” on the scale of “Michelle Obama (coarse facial

•

A black woman
labelled a “Negress” is depicted on her knees with a chain around her neck on a

•

Photo collage
depicting Megan Markle on hands and knees, wearing bra and thong, with a line of

standing to one side, says, “Sorry Madam but since returning from a British

an even swarthier clap trap if you had one.”  Beside him, a man in military
garb who is directing the clowns states (to a woman standing beside Markle),
“Madam, Harold fancies the demi-negress but I fear that once the clown troupe
exhausts its seed, she’ll be so worn the constabulary will be forced to put her
down.” (Tab 22, p. 10)

De-humanizing women by comparing them to dogs,
property, and reducing their worth to their genitals and reproductive
capabilities

•

In an article
providing advice to men on how to manipulate women into having sex with them
the day after Valentine’s Day, the author likens a man’s relationship to a

one’s possession.”  For a man to “be spontaneously romantic”, he “must feel

Women are

“In most western
countries today, even ravaging one’s own chattel (‘raping’ one’s wife) has been

Some women are not
“rape worthy” by virtue of their physical unattractiveness. (Tab 18, p. 10; Tab
22, p. 5, image caption)

A woman’s worth is
reduced to having a “grope-worthy pair of breasts!” (Tab 12, p. 14)

•

Women are warned that
their sexual market value is “about to plummet because at this very moment

Depicting women as liars, manipulators and as being

(Tab 12, pp. 10-11)

Women should not

“Most women are
irrational, short-sighted, passive-aggressive traitors who cannot be trusted

In describing why
women ought to be men’s chattel, Dimitri the Lover writes: “women have the emotional
maturity of children … but with advanced cunning which allows them to destroy a
family by manipulating its members into putting her interests ahead of those in

Celebrating and trivializing violence against women

•

for a change in terminology because “rape is such a trigger word nowadays”; instead,
Sears believes there should be a new and better way to describe forced sex,
